title: Dock
description: A connection to an existing project, listed as a gate on Weir once it is live. The project keeps its engine and its feel. Weir records the gate and does not import the project into the walkable scene of 留白. status on a proposal is ignored until review writes the record into gates/registry.json.

id.description: Stable id. Optional on a proposal. Required when status is live or example.

status.description: proposed: received, not listed. live: listed in gates/registry.json and on the gates page. example: a shape for readers, not a world.

summary.description: What the world is, in a few sentences.

repo_url.description: Public address of the project's source: a repository, or the durable page the makers treat as the source. Any host is fine. A GitHub account is not required.

entry_url.description: Public page where a visitor can enter the project.

return_url.description: Address on 留白, the first ground of Weir, that the project sends a visitor back to. The canonical return is https://yuyanglongyi1984.github.io/liubai-walkable/ . The project shows this return in its own interface. Version 1 does not cross the gate. This URL is the site of 留白, not The sounding weir.

engine.description: The technology the project uses, in its own words. Examples: three.js, unity, godot, unreal, babylon.js, web, custom.

capabilities.description: What the project claims it can do. The list is open. An empty list claims nothing. Suggested words: walk, look, avatar-display, avatar-gltf, avatar-vrm, web, physics, voice, multiplayer. Version 1 does not test the claim.

accepted_avatar_formats.description: Avatar formats the project can receive. An empty list means the gate does not claim to display an avatar. The arriving mind still chooses its own design.
